_comment: EGM Downloader Linux — informational, no auto-update. Upload to egerena.com/apps/egmlinux-update.json
_version_notes: Fixed the "What's New" update modal never appearing after an update
Fixed "Download All" getting stuck if a queued item was removed mid-run
Fixed queue reorder arrows sometimes moving the wrong item
Fixed a crash when switching a subscription's format after setting a per-video quality override
Fixed audio and video quality selections interfering with each other in some cases
Fixed the History window sometimes keeping the wrong theme colors after switching themes
Fixed a rare issue where importing a history backup could affect files outside the app's folder
Fixed a download getting stuck on "Queued" forever if the save folder became unavailable (e.g. an unplugged drive)
Fixed a download card getting stuck on "Downloading…" if the job was cleared from memory
Fixed the mini History panel permanently hiding half of each batch of entries
Fixed the Deno "Install" button doing nothing
Reinstalling Deno now applies immediately in the background — no restart needed

Fixed MP3/M4A/Opus downloads sometimes saving as VBR (variable bitrate) instead of the selected CBR bitrate — audio tools like MediaInfo, AIMP, and foobar2000 now correctly report the chosen bitrate (reported by @Krezzin, thank you!)
Rebalanced the Audio/Video format dropdowns in Settings so longer video format names display in full instead of getting cut off
Settings and Advanced panels now use a simple arrow instead of "Show"/"Hide" text to indicate expand/collapse state
New Sneakers theme category — 10 themes including Bred, Royal, Panda, and Grinch, plus a tribute pair honoring the shoe this project is named after: Brick by Brick and Brick After Brick
Theme catalog now totals 450 built-in themes
Frameless windows now have rounded corners by default, matching the existing look on Windows and macOS
App now shows its correct name and icon in the system volume/audio manager instead of generic "Chromium"
Electron runtime updated to v43.0.0 — includes Chromium and Node.js stability and security updates
New Modern theme category — 20 themes covering internet-culture and lifestyle aesthetics, from Clean Girl and Dark Academia to Algorithm and Y2K Revival
Theme catalog now totals 440 built-in themes
Electron runtime updated to v42.5.1 — includes upstream Chromium stability improvements backported from the latest Chromium releases
Update feed — What's New now shows only the relevant bullets for each platform, with internal tags stripped; previously all platforms could receive bullets intended for a different OS
Automated test coverage extended — update feed content is now validated on every CI run; catches feed generation issues before release rather than during signing
Optional libraries — brotli, pycryptodomex, websockets, and certifi bundled alongside curl_cffi across all platforms; improves yt-dlp site compatibility and SSL reliability out of the box
Optional libraries — new update card in Advanced → Plugins; check and update all five libraries independently without waiting for an app release
Universal MP4 — now the default output format across all platforms; H.264 + AAC, plays on any device; already-H.264 files are remuxed without re-encoding
Settings panel — redesigned into two side-by-side boxes: Download folder + Format/Quality on the left, Site Cookies on the right; cleaner layout with proper labels and breathing room
Themes panel — Create theme at the top; recent themes list below; View all themes, Import, and Export redesigned as proper footer buttons
History panel — action buttons now SVG icons, hidden until hover; thumbnails enlarged to 48×36; cleaner header with total count; unified footer with Show older and Clear all
Expanded history — action buttons match the main UI panel: SVG icons, hover-reveal, consistent sizing
Keyboard shortcut — Ctrl+K opens the Theme Creator from anywhere in the app; listed in the help modal
Universal MP4 — Linux and Mac now correctly default to Universal MP4 on fresh installs; was Windows-only previously

Optional libraries panel — Linux and Mac show installed versions informally; update action remains Windows-only, consistent with the mutagen model; versions load immediately on first panel expand without requiring a manual check
History panel — Show older pill no longer accumulates in the footer on repeated panel refreshes
Expanded history — horizontal scrollbar suppressed; no longer appears on window resize
Thumbnail fallbacks — emoji placeholders (🎬 ♫ ▶) replaced with inline SVG icons across all templates
Format selector — MP4 · H.264 (Max compatibility) now listed first, matching its default status
URL card — inner content pixel-aligned with the Settings boxes below; textarea edges now flush with Download folder and Site Cookies borders
Themes window — All count now includes imported themes and updates live; Imported count and delete handler corrected
Import theme dialog — cleaned up; shows theme name and color preview; Cancel and Apply Theme
JS syntax gate — new pytest guard checks every JS template module on both platforms; catches syntax errors that bypass all other tests
History panel — title, filename, and URL fields now escaped before rendering; prevents stored XSS from attacker-controlled download metadata
